input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
cases: whiledo_simple: b0->b1(cond)->b2(body)/b3(exit), b2->b1 back — condition chain flagged (bump=1), body not, loop own flag cleared (root bump=false)
dowhile_simple: b0->b1(body)->b2(bottom)->b1 back/b3 exit — body list + front copy flagged, dowhile cleared
infloop_simple: b0->b1, b1->b1 self back — body list + front copy flagged, infloop cleared

nested_loops_front: WhileDo at the FRONT of a DoWhile body (next_url shape minus the unstructured edge) — the forced-true front chain makes the INNER WhileDo keep bump=1 (cc:3320 !bump is false) while the DoWhile clears its own; the differentiator against flat-mark or unconditional-clear ports
straight_line: b0->b1->b2, no loops — control, nothing flagged

observation_schema.format: per case: 'case <name>', 'roots=<n>', one 'type=<t> bump=<0|1> kids=<n>' line per tree node (sorted), then 'end'
